title: Analyzing Social Exchange Motives With Theory-Driven Data and Machine Learning

items.verbatim_quote: predicting motive from interaction traces presents a new challenge: While intent predominantly anticipates ‘what’ actions people or artificial agents will take [8], motives explore the ‘why’ behind these actions, revealing the underlying reason.
items.author_claim_cn: 作者指出，从交互轨迹预测动机是一个新挑战，因为意图主要预测“什么”行动，而动机探究行动背后的“为什么”。

items.verbatim_quote: While Bolle et al. [28] analyzed motives in a game context that relied on explicitly defined reward values, the open social exchange used in our study has no defined reward for actions. Also, there was no indication of whether the utility function can predict the players’ ‘unseen’ motives.
items.author_claim_cn: 作者批评Bolle等人的研究依赖于明确定义的奖励值，而本研究使用的开放社会交换没有定义奖励；且未表明效用函数能否预测玩家“未见的”动机。

items.verbatim_quote: This is an oversimplification because each allocation may be informed by multiple motives.
items.author_claim_cn: 作者承认，将每次分配视为仅由单一动机驱动是一种过度简化，因为每次分配可能受多种动机影响。

items.verbatim_quote: predicting motives from interaction traces in a social exchange context is relatively unexplored. Thus, it is important to first test well-known basic algorithms.
items.author_claim_cn: 作者承认从社交交换中的互动轨迹预测动机是一个相对未被探索的领域，因此本研究首先测试了基本的机器学习算法。

items.verbatim_quote: the current study refrained from explicitly interpreting each cluster
items.author_claim_cn: 作者指出本研究未对每个聚类进行明确解释。

items.verbatim_quote: SVC is known to underperform when dealing with imbalanced classes [63].
items.author_claim_cn: 作者批评支持向量分类器在处理不平衡类别时表现不佳。

items.verbatim_quote: a critique that can be made of this study is whether the ground truth is accurate. Self-reporting introduces inherent biases, including impression management, such as faking and lying [68]. This raised the question: why should we place trust in individuals’ self-disclosures? Consequently, self-reporting does not serve as a benchmark for accurately identifying motives. In our study, we combined previous moves and the knowledge of well-established theories on social exchanges to identify motives signaled by the recipient’s identity. While this approach mitigated the trust issues associated with self-reporting, it introduced a dependency on, and necessitated trust in, psychological theories about motives in social exchanges.
items.author_claim_cn: 作者承认，本研究的一个可批评之处在于其真实标签的准确性：虽然避免了自我报告带来的印象管理等偏见，但方法依赖于并需要信任关于社会交换动机的心理学理论。

items.verbatim_quote: its performance indicated that it was susceptible to an imbalanced dataset.
items.author_claim_cn: 作者指出，C-HMM算法的性能表明它对不平衡数据集敏感。

items.verbatim_quote: An improvement would be to incorporate a search strategy that penalizes the algorithm when it is biased toward a class.
items.author_claim_cn: 作者建议，未来的改进可以引入一种搜索策略，当算法偏向某一类别时对其进行惩罚。

items.verbatim_quote: Self-reporting introduces inherent biases, including impression management, such as faking and lying [68].
items.author_claim_cn: 作者批评自我报告方法引入固有偏见，包括印象管理，如伪装和说谎。

items.verbatim_quote: only a limited body of literature has focused on the ‘why’ based intent.
items.author_claim_cn: 作者指出，只有有限的文献关注了基于“为什么”的意图。

items.verbatim_quote: The prediction of ‘why’ based intent using interaction traces like the clickstream and interaction network, however, remains relatively unexplored.
items.author_claim_cn: 作者指出，使用点击流和交互网络等交互轨迹预测基于“为什么”的意图仍然相对未被探索。
